It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 15, 2021}} The district encompasses the western half of [[Masbate Island]] consisting of the provincial capital [[Masbate City]] and the municipalities of [[Aroroy]], [[Baleno, Masbate|Baleno]], [[Balud]], [[Mandaon]], [[Milagros, Masbate|Milagros]] and [[Mobo, Masbate|Mobo]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 15, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Olga Kho]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]].{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 15, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
